2608.02441.title: Agentic Commerce World: An Auditable and Verifiable Environment for Vibe Commerce
2608.02441.paper_summary: In vibe coding, people describe software in natural language and delegate implementation to AI agents. By analogy, vibe commerce allows people to express buying or selling goals in natural language and delegate the corresponding tasks to agents. Commerce, however, requires independently controlled Buyer and Merchant agents to interact in a shared market while preserving their private objectives and distinct authority. We introduce Agentic Commerce World (ACWorld), an environment for evaluating such agents across ongoing transactions. Through its Vibe Commerce Protocol (VCP), ACWorld validates agent actions before updating shared transaction state and records the resulting interactions, making agent behavior auditable and evaluation reproducible. The ACWorld Benchmark contains a 200-task capability-coverage track and a 60-task large-catalog track that searches 785,022 transactable listings. Across ten models, mean scores range from 65.9% to 85.6% and from 56.1% to 91.4%, respectively. Our analysis shows that process-level evidence is necessary: final state alone can miss evaluated errors, incomplete trajectories still retain useful process signals, and large-catalog tasks expose bottlenecks across stages.
2608.02441.paper_summary_zh: 在氛圍編碼中，人們用自然語言描述軟體，並將實現委託給 AI 代理。類比地，氛圍商務允許人們用自然語言表達購買或銷售目標，並將相應的任務委託給代理。然而，商務需要獨立控制的買方和商方代理在共享市場中互動，同時保持他們的私人目標和不同的權威。我們介紹了代理商務世界（ACWorld），這是一個評估這些代理在持續交易中的環境。通過其氛圍商務協議（VCP），ACWorld 在更新共享交易狀態之前驗證代理行為並記錄結果互動，使代理行為可審計且評估可重現。ACWorld 基準包含 200 項任務能力覆蓋追蹤和 60 項大型目錄追蹤，搜索 785,022 個可交易清單。在十個模型中，平均得分範圍分別為 65.9% 到 85.6% 和 56.1% 到 91.4%。我們的分析顯示，過程級別的證據是必要的：僅最終狀態可能會錯過評估錯誤，不完整的軌跡仍然保留有用的過程信號，而大型目錄任務則暴露了各階段的瓶頸。
